## Ingredients

- 2 scoops protein powder  
- 1 handful spinach  
- ½ cup Greek yogurt  
- 1 banana  
- ⅓ cup mixed berries  
- ½ tablespoon flaxseed  
- ⅓ tablespoon chia seeds  
- 1 tablespoon honey  
- Water, to desired consistency  

## Instructions

1. Add all ingredients to a blender.  
2. Blend until smooth, adding water gradually until you reach your preferred thickness.  
3. Pour into a glass and enjoy immediately.  

## Notes

- For a creamier smoothie, replace water with almond milk or oat milk.  
- Add ice cubes before blending for a chilled version.  
- Great post-workout or as a quick meal replacement.
